current_task_binding.dataset_name: CHIRPS Precipitation Daily: Climate Hazards Center InfraRed Precipitation With Station Data (Version 2.0 Final)

spatial_coverage.coverage: Quasi-global land precipitation coverage from 50 degrees S to 50 degrees N, including mainland Australia and Tasmania.

current_task_binding.spatial_resolution: 0.05 degree grid, approximately 5.6 km at the equator
analytical_capabilities: Aggregate daily rainfall to pentad, monthly, seasonal or annual precipitation totals
Compute precipitation anomalies, drought indicators and return-period summaries
Drive hydrological, land-surface, vegetation or hazard models with gridded rainfall
Compare rainfall patterns across basins, climate zones, elevations or land-cover contexts
Validate or benchmark other precipitation products against a station-blended satellite rainfall record

unit_of_measurement.primary_measurement: Daily precipitation depth in millimeters per day
unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Use the precipitation band. Summing daily values gives accumulated precipitation over the chosen period; averaging daily values gives mean daily intensity for that period. Do not treat CHIRPS-Prelim, CHIRPS v3 daily SAT/RNL variants, IMERG, ERA5-Land, MSWEP or FLDAS outputs as the same asset unless the task explicitly asks for a separate comparison.

current_task_binding.data_source: UCSB Climate Hazards Group CHIRPS version 2.0 Final
current_task_binding.region_scope_provenance: replacement seed full text (10.5194/hess-25-4185-2021) section 2.1 uses Australia as the case study, while section 2.2 uses CHIRPS precipitation forcing on a 0.05 degree grid

observation_identity_contract.source_lineage: UCSB Climate Hazards Group CHIRPS version 2.0 Final, blending infrared satellite precipitation estimates with in-situ station observations
observation_identity_contract.core_measurement_semantics: 0.05 degree gridded precipitation depth in millimeters, represented in the GEE daily collection as the precipitation band in mm/day
observation_identity_contract.non_material_variations: CHIRPS v2.0 daily, pentad or monthly aggregations; spatial reprojection, clipping, basin averaging, temporal aggregation or disaggregation that preserves CHIRPS v2.0 precipitation amounts
observation_identity_contract.material_mismatches: CHIRP without station blending, CHIRPS-Prelim near-real-time products, CHIRPS v3 products unless explicitly justified as an equivalent successor, IMERG, PERSIANN, MSWEP, ERA5-Land precipitation, FLDAS or other downstream products merely forced by CHIRPS

original_anchor_asset.asset_alias_policy: Admit operational use of CHIRPS version 2.0 Final precipitation, including UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/DAILY, UCSB-CHG/CHIRPS/PENTAD, explicit CHIRPS v2.0 daily/pentad/monthly data, or publisher-hosted CHIRPS v2.0 files preserving the same precipitation observation. Generic CHIRPS mentions remain unresolved if the paper gives no product/version or use evidence. CHIRPS v3, CHIRPS-Prelim, CHIRP-only and other satellite precipitation products are not direct aliases unless a later adjudication explicitly establishes observation equivalence.
original_anchor_asset.alias_policy_scope: A paper need not reproduce the seed's Australia case study, CABLE model, GRACE assimilation, grid, temporal disaggregation or validation design. Methods/Data must establish that CHIRPS precipitation itself is read, processed, modeled, validated, compared or used as an input variable.
